title: A member card that opens another site opens it through Frequency, so closing the site lands on Frequency
detail: Owner ask 2026-10-22: his card No. 0001 opens thegrouplocal.com, and with the Frequency app installed the site showed in the app's in-app window; closing it should go to Frequency. /c/<token> still counts the tap, pays the connect and drops the referral cookie, then sends a link to Frequency's own site (apex or www, isOwnSiteLink) straight there as before, and a link to anywhere else to /card/<token>/go?n=<nonce>. That page opens the site once; a visitor who comes back to it (the in-app window closed, or Back in a browser) is sent on to Frequency's home. The nonce keys the mark in sessionStorage so the next tap opens the site again. Follows LIVE-1282 and ADR-1874; no migration.
